conditions: No production producer, exported setter, public schema/API, runtimeToolGate activation, checker registration or Goal LIVE exception is added.

Nil carrier preserves the existing Run branch. The opt-in branch must preserve Run's actual Start(ctx)+Wait(context.Background()) complete-wait semantics; do not introduce Wait(ctx), early cleanup of the Host staging directory, or a new cancellation/cleanup deadline in this slice.

Evidence claims only candidate bytes observed in the final private copy BEFORE_RESUME, associated with a matching complete receipt. It does not prove all compiler inputs, absence of same-OS-user mutation, later compiler file reads, business correctness, native qualification or original business approval.
Explicit strict inventory/path/reparse checks supplement os.Root; os.Root alone is not a no-link or exact-spelling predicate.
Fresh-directory fixtures test capture, filtering, selector and identity predicates only. They do not call sandbox Start/Run, start processes/listeners, open DBs, access formal holdout or run models.
outside_six_paths: Existing sandbox parent-exit/child-pipe cleanup defect requires its own lifecycle source slice before real activation.
Runtime-period write exclusion, final toolchain/vendor-copy verification, trusted context factory, native execution evidence, canonical business checker and Task/Goal acceptance remain separate work.

findings.claim: The actual seam is after the final copy and suspended atomic-Job process creation, before ResumeThread.
findings.constraint: Read final input/source only from the callback-provided Host identity. Bound callback work and check cancellation explicitly: command timeout begins only after callback/Resume at line337. Do not expose callback or identity construction to JSON.

findings.claim: Candidate bytes are writable until the current check snapshot. Prepare A -> authorized edit B -> staged B -> final B is admissible; staged B -> final C is rejected.
findings.constraint: Freeze roster and fixed-input digests in private context, not candidate prepare-time content. Compare final candidate against the current Host-created sourceManifest, then validate/hash/serialize the same owned bytes; never reread a mutable path for evidence. Keep go.mod/test source bytes out of evidence, logs and errors.

findings.claim: os.Root is containment with link resolution, not exact roster or no-reparse enforcement.
findings.constraint: Use only exact literal go.mod, pkg/solution.go, pkg/solution_test.go and the single pkg directory, with bounded depth/entry counts/byte sizes; reject extras including empty dirs and vendor, missing files, case changes/collisions, backslashes, dot segments, ADS/colon, trailing-dot/space aliases, absolute/drive/UNC/device names and any reparse attribute at every traversed component. Enumerate actual names rather than accepting a cleaned alias. Check opened handles are expected regular files and retain handle-relative reads; do not use Lstat followed by an unconstrained absolute os.ReadFile as a substitute. Initial OpenRoot follows its supplied root path, so provenance comes from the trusted fresh staging identity, not a caller path. Root's sharing permits write/delete; state same-user mutation exclusion is unproved rather than inferring it from Root. Hardlink/handle alias tests should be rejected if no-alias is claimed; otherwise narrow the claim explicitly.

findings.claim: Only five callback identity fields are present directly in Receipt; StagingDirectory is not.
findings.constraint: Require nonzero PID/Created and nonempty Job/SID/Profile, exact callback-to-receipt PID/Created/Job/SID/Profile, plus derived Directory==staging/output and expected remapped executable/argv. Do not claim direct receipt StagingDirectory equality. Verify capabilities remain empty. No fake or caller-supplied native identity.

findings.claim: Run already uses Start(ctx)+Wait(Background); Wait(ctx) would weaken cleanup ownership on cancellation.
findings.constraint: Set beforeLaunch=false before Start, retain UNKNOWN on launch/callback/Wait errors, and publish no usable capture unless Wait returned without error and Stopped/StreamsDrained/CleanupComplete/OutputCopied are all true. Preserve exit_code and timed_out as execution outcome; zero exit and structural capture are not business PASS. CleanupComplete covers staging deletion only, not confirmed success of deferred DeleteAppContainerProfile/CloseHandle.

findings.claim: Existing RuntimeToolRequest is an in-process port assembled by domain; an unexported concrete pointer can carry a private optional context without adding wire authority.
findings.constraint: Keep carrier field/type private and non-interface where possible. Read-only accessor distinguishes nil from invalid nonnil and returns defensive copies of every nested slice/map/byte field. No exported setter, public JSON decoder, context.WithValue request bridge, policy marker or check_id convention may mint it. Host may consume a validated read-only view; Host tests can call pure helpers with explicitly synthetic views without creating an exported production test factory. New non-Windows domain files must remain portable; Windows-only types cannot leak into runtime_tools.go. Private context hashes are provenance, never authentication. Current no-producer status must remain explicit.

findings.claim: Existing broker strips host_evidence from model reply, hashes canonical evidence and enforces the 4MiB budget.
findings.constraint: Add candidate-only capture to full evidence before the existing bound, never to model-visible metadata/content. Full evidence includes JSON/base64 overhead. No fixed test/go.mod/toolchain/vendor bytes, no new reportRun/SDK result IDs, no model-supplied artifact provenance. Receipt outcome remains independent of capture validity.

findings.claim: The current second copy of toolchain/vendor is not hashed again in the proposed candidate-only callback, and same-OS-user FA remains.
findings.constraint: Label evidence as a before-resume candidate snapshot associated with a completed run. Do not call it full compiler-input attestation or proof the compiler subsequently consumed B. Complete trusted toolchain provenance, runtime write exclusion and Native/ACL verification are later activation prerequisites.

findings.claim: A parent that exits while a child retains stdout/stderr can bypass later timeout polling and block cleanup/Job-close.
findings.constraint: Track in sandbox-child-drain-review.md. Do not expand the six-path candidate slice to fix lifecycle or silently claim existing cleanup is time-bounded. No native qualification until a separately scoped lifecycle fix and appropriate native validation.

fixture_acceptance_matrix: A prepare/B current staging/B final accepted as capture; B staged/C final rejected even semantically equivalent.
Fixed file hash/sizes, roster, suite/check/binding/contract/policy identity drift rejected; only candidate is writable.
Exact path and regular-file inventory, case aliases, extra/missing/emptydir/vendor, reparse, path escape and byte/entry/depth budgets.
Invalid UTF8/AST/token/type/size budget rejected by existing deliverygate; no candidate execution required.
Defensive copies: mutate input buffer, source inventory, accessor view or evidence candidate bytes and ensure sealed owner bytes/hash do not change.
JSON names matching private carrier and policy/check-name markers cannot opt in; nil retains old selector; malformed nonnil rejects without fallback.
Five identity fields and derived paths mismatch, Wait error or incomplete receipt prevents usable capture; nonzero/timeout never semantic PASS.
Distinct fixed-file sentinels absent from capture/evidence/errors and model-visible reply; full encoded evidence >4MiB rejected.

diagnostics.detail: One auxiliary rg call used GOROOT cwd for internal/host and a Windows literal *.go path; both locators were invalid. Correct small-directory discoveries subsequently succeeded as 1d634a/2ebb21. No product/test command ran.
Initial combined four-file readiness read exceeded output budget; each relevant input was read separately. No state mutation or test result inferred.
